scope: Resolve workbench-settings-write-contract OA role sync blocker by replacing synchronous Python OA role sync semantics with Rust/Axum PostgreSQL identity role provisioning request, worker task, and outbox enqueue semantics.

source_blocker.legacy_python_behavior: POST /api/workbench/settings synchronously called OARoleSyncService.sync_access_control and returned oa_role_sync_failed when the OA MySQL role sync failed.
source_blocker.implemented_rust_behavior: POST /api/workbench/settings saves the PostgreSQL settings profile fact and queues app.identity_provisioning_requests + job.worker_tasks + job.outbox_events in the same PostgreSQL transaction. The request path does not connect to or write OA MySQL.

recommended_decision.decision: Move OA role provisioning out of the settings write request path and treat settings write success as settings fact persisted plus identity role provisioning queued.
rationale: Keeps POST /api/workbench/settings independent from OA MySQL availability.
Preserves audit/idempotency on the PostgreSQL write boundary.
Creates explicit worker/outbox lineage for retry, health, and alerting instead of hiding role sync failure inside the settings route.

implemented_contract.success_semantics: HTTP success means the workbench settings PostgreSQL fact is active and the identity role provisioning request/job/outbox is queued or an identical access_control provisioning request already exists. It does not mean OA roles have been applied.

payload_contract.secret_policy: No password, token, secret, credential, URI, or raw file content is included in provisioning payloads.

idempotency.settings_write: Existing app.write_idempotency_records operation=settings.save remains authoritative; the same idempotency key with a different request payload returns 409.
idempotency.provisioning: app.identity_provisioning_requests has unique guards for (settings_profile_id, settings_version), idempotency_key, and payload_hash. payload_hash is derived from schema_version/source/access_control/assignments so identical access_control does not create duplicate provisioning work.

explicit_non_changes: No synchronous OA MySQL write was added.
Data reset worker files and Prompt07 final report files were not intentionally modified by this task.
Product/ops approval was not forged or marked complete.

human_approval_required.decision: Approve that POST /api/workbench/settings success no longer means OA roles are already synchronized.
Approve UI, health, alerting, and runbook wording for queued/running/failed identity role provisioning.
Define worker failure SLA, retry/dead-letter handling, escalation thresholds, and recovery evidence requirements.

remaining_risks: The worker execution path and OA-side apply proof still require staging evidence.
UI and health endpoints must surface role provisioning queued/running/failed states before users rely on the new contract.
Alerting must distinguish settings persistence success from identity provisioning completion.
